title: Intraday Periodicity and Volatility Persistence, Revisited: A Replication and Extension of Andersen & Bollerslev (1997)
description:
Replication and extension of Andersen & Bollerslev (1997, Journal of Empirical Finance 4, 115-158) on EUR/USD (2004-2025), S&P 500 (2010-2025) and BTC/USDT (2018-2025) using free, key-less data sources. Includes: a fully reproducible Python pipeline (pinned with uv); a week-by-week correction of an undocumented timestamp convention in HistData; replication of all figures and Tables 1-5; a zero-robust Poisson pseudo-ML estimator of the Flexible Fourier Form; rolling-window robustness of GARCH aggregation consistency; strict walk-forward out-of-sample tests of intraday volatility forecasts, risk targeting and intraday mean-return trading rules after costs; the research paper (PDF), figures and tables.

Market data are not redistributed; scripts download them from the original providers.
